notes.title: Final Content Update
notes.content:
<FAKE HEART> Main Director KIM-BLAN here.

I have something to say regarding this update, so I'll start with this message.

Back in February and March, we shared updates regarding our official release.
To summarize, [b]"The game content is already completed, with only language translations remaining."[/b]

We had planned to complete translations such as Chinese and English through an overseas publisher.
However, due to [b]unilateral errors by the publisher[/b], we still haven't received the translation materials after four months.
We have addressed this issue with our Korean BD manager.
However, even if we were to commission translations again now, it would take a minimum of three months for them to be completed and implemented.

[u][b]Therefore, we would like to offer the final content that we planned to add upon the official release immediately.[/b][/u]
You have already waited patiently for quite some time.

Thank you very much for your patience,
and we sincerely apologize for keeping you waiting for so long.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014464/0808ff41c57a4b6cd3bed28cf656c37381fce736.jpg[/img]

♥ Update Version: v.1.0.0

he final content currently supports Korean and Japanese only.
Included contents are as follows:

[list]
[*] 2 Hidden Stories
[*] 5 Easter Eggs
[*] 3 Endings
[/list]

The Easter Eggs are scattered throughout the entire game,
and you can encounter the endings in the places you've been most curious about.

Farewell to Wonderland :(

notes.title: Expanding Supported Languages and Official Release:
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's amazing how the cold winter has retreated and spring is once again crossing the threshold of the season. Throughout this time, we have received an abundance of love and sincere support from all of you. It seems that the time to sprout has finally arrived.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014464/2034c69f24cc3721473344421cf9b416dfacbfaf.jpg[/img]

During the past period, we have been continuously working on incorporating the final contents, along with making numerous adjustments and enhancements. Currently, all game-related content has been fully developed, and we are in the process of wrapping up the language-related tasks.

Ultimately, the following languages will be added to the game:

[list]
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese
[*] English
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[/list]
Upon official release, the game price will increase by a minimum of 30% compared to the Early Access period, depending on the additional content added since then. We will provide detailed scheduling once the language tasks are completed.

For more details, please refer to our official blog:
https://blog.naver.com/blanbee/223345685834


Thank you.
